title: Unify composeStacks to @objectstack/spec, remove @object-ui/core implementation
body:
Eliminates the duplicate `composeStacks` in `@object-ui/core`, switching all usage to the canonical `@objectstack/spec` implementation.

### Removed
- `packages/core/src/utils/compose-stacks.ts` and its 15-test suite

### Switched to `@objectstack/spec`
- `objectstack.config.ts` and `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts` now import from `@objectstack/spec`
- A deprecated re-export of `composeStacks` is kept in `@object-ui/core` for backward compatibility, forwarding to `@objectstack/spec` with a JSDoc migration note

### Adapter logic for behavioral gaps
Two things the spec version doesn't do that the core version did:

- **`manifest.data` aggregation** — spec selects one manifest (`'last'` by default), so seed data is now collected manually before composing:
  ```ts
  const allData = allConfigs.flatMap((c: any) => c.manifest?.data || c.data || []);
  ```
- **`views[].listViews` → objects merge** — runtime expects `listViews` on each object, but spec doesn't do this mapping. Extracted to `@object-ui/core/utils/merge-views-into-objects.ts` as a shared adapter with MIT license header, applied post-composition at both call sites. Includes 6 unit tests covering merging, preserving existing listViews, ignoring views without `data.object`, empty/missing views, and multi-object merging. This remains temporary per ROADMAP (planned move to runtime/provider layer).

### ROADMAP
Updated to reflect unified composeStacks, clarified that the removed 15-test suite coverage now lives upstream in `@objectstack/spec`, and corrected historical references from `@object-ui/core` to `@objectstack/spec`.
